newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato says Greenspan comments not alarming.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato says Greenspan comments not alarming.

text.p: Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Thursday that Federal Reserve President Alan Greenspan's recent comments warning of a possible interest rate rise in the U.S. were not alarming or worrying since they referred to an economy which was at a different part of its cycle.

"At the moment, the economic cycles aren't necessarily the same, instead we are in a European growth phase. On the other hand I wouldn't be alarmed by his comments yesterday which are probably those that he had to make and shouldn't surprise us," Rato told journalists on the fringes of a seminar.
